messages:
ian-sales: POC note - ACME on Dedicated: console shows x-rwd-traceid but their Kibana lacks trace_id; our log-drain shows 429s.
maria-se: Are 429s from our drain or their collector? Share sample header.
ian-sales: Drain error: "429 rate limit exceeded: log-drain-default". We inject x-rwd-traceid: rwd-20240315-7f9b.
sam-eng: Probably header stripped by LB or fluent-bit mapping missing + drain backpressure. Do they have an F5?
acme-eng: Yes, F5 TLS-terminating in front of fluent-bit. We'll check.
maria-se: Fluent-bit needs header mapping (Header x-rwd-traceid trace_id). If LB strips, set proxy_pass_header X-Request-ID.
sam-eng: We can temporarily increase drain_retry_max=10 and burst_buffer=500MB for 48h if needed. Devops to apply after header validated.
julie-ps: Note POC uplift may affect Dedicated commits. Ian, confirm ACME ok with transient window.
ian-sales: They requested 24h onboarding uplift; agreed to transient buffer if we can't fix fast.
devops-bot: Scheduled change: increase-log-drain-burst for tenant acme-corp -> applying now. Monitor 5m.
ian-sales: ACME ran a curl test; LB stripped header. They're enabling proxy_pass_header X-Request-ID and will rerun.
maria-se: Once header flows, map to trace_id and link console traces <-> Kibana. If still missing, ask them to disable sampling for 1min during test.
security-bot: For Private/on-prem BYOK we need customer's KMS ARN. See intranet.
ian-sales: Will post results & raw captures here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
